comparison.objective: Open a can using a hand-held rotary opener; candidate screens finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain a clamp while coordinating continuous key rotation around a rim versus coordinated screen grasping and bridge-clearing agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Lid fully cut, opener removed, can upright and released versus ≥98% recovery, all washers retained, no loss or damage, and screen released on supports.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is generic; cutting a continuous seam does not test granular separation.
